note: Every URL present in the sitemap of the previous megatools.live build, captured 2026-08-07. These are already known to Google. Any one of them that 404s is a page whose indexing is thrown away, so the gate requires each to either exist or be held by a redirect.
pendingRedirectsNote: Legacy URLs whose replacement tool has not been built yet. The new site went live before these existed, so without this they return a hard 404 and Google drops them from the index within weeks. These are emitted as TEMPORARY (307) redirects, never permanent: the intent is to restore each URL with its own page, and a 301 would tell Google the address is gone for good. Targets point at the category hub where that hub already has tools on it, and at /tools otherwise. Delete an entry the moment its tool ships. A redirect is matched before a page is served, so a stale entry would make the new page unreachable; check-legacy-urls.mts fails the build if that happens.
